answer: The pigment test I would run is EEG attention signature during a twenty-second task: a brainwave pattern recorded while solving a shown puzzle, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the falcon of that gap is the whole defence in one line. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the yarrow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
